passkeyProvider.title: Passkeys in Windows
passkeyProvider.help: Let Windows and your browsers save and use passkeys from Octa Pass.
passkeyProvider.switch: Use Octa Pass as a passkey provider
passkeyProvider.switchHelp: Off by default, and only for this device. Each use asks for Windows Hello.
passkeyProvider.enable: Turn on Octa Pass in Windows Settings
passkeyProvider.enableHelp: One more step: Windows asks you to turn it on under Accounts → Passkeys → Advanced options.
passkeyProvider.enabled: Windows is using Octa Pass for passkeys.
passkeyProvider.failed: Windows didn’t accept the change. Try again.

quick.copied: {what} for {title} copied. The clipboard clears in {count} s.

autoType.copied: Auto-type isn’t available here, so the password for {title} was copied. The clipboard clears in {count} s.
autoType.permission: To type, Octa Pass needs the Accessibility permission: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility.
autoType.screenLocked: The screen is locked, so nothing was typed.
autoType.noWindow: There’s no window to type into.
autoType.ownWindow: Octa Pass doesn’t type into its own windows.
autoType.noMatch: {window} isn’t a window for {title}. Add its title to the login’s auto-type windows in Octa Pass.
autoType.keysHeld: Let go of the keys, then try again.
autoType.invalidSequence: The auto-type sequence of {title} has a mistake. Fix it in Octa Pass.
autoType.noLogin: No login is set up for {window}. Pick one, or add the window to a login’s auto-type windows.

quick.signedOut: Sign in to Octa Pass first
quick.unlockFailed: Not unlocked. Try again, or open Octa Pass and use your master password.
